select zbcode,zbname,jslx,p1name,p1val,p2name,p2val,score,yjmsg,sysw,syqy,yxbz,p3name,p3val,p4name,p4val from ( select s.zbcode,s.zbname,s.jslx, s.p1name, nvl(t.p1val,s.p1val) as p1val, s.p2name, nvl(t.p2val,s.p2val) as p2val, s.p3name, nvl(t.p3val,s.p3val) as p3val, s.p4name, nvl(t.p4val,s.p4val) as p4val, nvl(t.score,s.score) as score, s.yjmsg, t.swjgdm,s.sysw,s.syqy,nvl(t.yxbz,'Y') as yxbz, row_number() over(partition by s.zbcode order by t.swjgdm desc) as RN from YJ_DIC_YJZB s left join YJ_DIC_YJZBSWJG t on (s.zbcode=t.zbcode and t.yxbz='Y' and (t.swjgdm=#{swjgdm} or (substr(t.swjgdm,1,5)=substr(#{swjgdm},1,5) and substr(t.swjgdm,-6)='000000'))) where s.sysw='1' ) where RN=1 order by zbcode

SELECT T.LCSLID,T.YJ_OBJECT,T.YJ_RECORD,T.YJ_COUNT,T.YJ_AMT,T.YJ_TAX,y.ckqygllb_dm as ckqygllbDm, (SELECT B.SBHGSPMC FROM HX_CKTS.CKTS_SB_MDT_TSSB_GCB B WHERE B.LCSLID=T.LCSLID AND B.SBXH=T.YJ_RECORD AND SUBSTR(B.CKSP_DM,1,8)=T.YJ_OBJECT AND ROWNUM=1) AS CMNAME FROM (SELECT A.DJXH, A.LCSLID, SUBSTR(A.CKSP_DM,1,8) AS YJ_OBJECT, MIN(A.SBXH) AS YJ_RECORD, COUNT(1) AS YJ_COUNT, SUM(A.MYLAJ) AS YJ_AMT, SUM(A.MDTSE) AS YJ_TAX, MIN(A.CKRQ_1) AS CKRQ0 FROM HX_CKTS.CKTS_SB_MDT_TSSB_GCB A WHERE LCSLID = #{lcslid} GROUP BY A.DJXH,A.LCSLID,SUBSTR(A.CKSP_DM,1,8) HAVING SUM(A.MDTSE) >#{pval1} ) T left join hx_ckts.ckts_ty_ywblxx y on y.djxh=T.DJXH AND nvl(y.zfbz_1, 'N') = 'N' AND nvl(y.FFBZ, 'N') = 'N' and y.lcslid=T.LCSLID WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HX_CKTS.CKTS_SB_MDT_TSSB_JGB S WHERE S.DJXH = T.DJXH AND SUBSTR(S.CKSP_DM,1,8) = T.YJ_OBJECT AND S.CKRQ_1 >=ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(T.CKRQ0,'YY'),-24))

WITH GLMX AS ( SELECT A1.DJXH,A1.LCSLID,A1.CKSP_DM,A1.GLH,A1.CKRQ_1,A1.MYLAJ, (SELECT SUM(A2.TSE) FROM HX_CKTS.CKTS_SB_MTS_TSJH_GCB A2 WHERE A2.DJXH=A1.DJXH AND A2.GLH=A1.GLH) AS TSE FROM HX_CKTS.CKTS_SB_MTS_TSSB_GCB A1 WHERE A1.LCSLID = #{lcslid} ), FZTJ AS ( SELECT A.DJXH,A.LCSLID, SUBSTR(A.CKSP_DM,1,6) AS YJ_OBJECT, MIN(A.GLH) AS YJ_RECORD, COUNT(1) AS YJ_COUNT, SUM(A.MYLAJ) AS YJ_AMT, SUM(A.TSE) AS YJ_TAX, MIN(A.CKRQ_1) AS CKRQ0 FROM GLMX A GROUP BY A.DJXH,A.LCSLID,SUBSTR(A.CKSP_DM,1,6) HAVING SUM(A.TSE) > #{pval1} ) SELECT T.LCSLID,T.YJ_OBJECT,T.YJ_RECORD,T.YJ_COUNT,T.YJ_AMT,T.YJ_TAX,y.ckqygllb_dm as ckqygllbDm, (SELECT B.SBHGSPMC FROM HX_CKTS.CKTS_SB_MTS_TSSB_GCB B WHERE B.LCSLID=T.LCSLID AND B.GLH=T.YJ_RECORD) AS CMNAME FROM FZTJ T left join hx_ckts.ckts_ty_ywblxx y on y.djxh=T.DJXH AND nvl(y.zfbz_1, 'N') = 'N' AND nvl(y.FFBZ, 'N') = 'N' and y.lcslid=T.LCSLID WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HX_CKTS.CKTS_SB_MTS_TSSB_JGB S WHERE S.DJXH = T.DJXH AND SUBSTR(S.CKSP_DM,1,6) = T.YJ_OBJECT AND S.CKRQ_1 >=ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(T.CKRQ0,'YY'),-24))

select object as yj_object, '' as yj_record, yj_count, yj_amt, yj_tax, cmname from (select substr(cmcode,1,8) as object, min(cmname) as cmname, count(*) as yj_count, sum(usd_amt) as yj_amt, sum(tse) as yj_tax, min(lj_date) as lj_date0 from (select a.cksp_dm as cmcode, a.sbhgspmc as cmname, a.mylaj as usd_amt, a.mdtse as tse, a.ckrq_1 as lj_date from tl_bjts.ckts_sb_mdt_tssb_lsb a where sbid in (select id from tl_bjts.sb_sbxx_hz where nsrdzdah =#{nsrdzdah} and sbrq >= to_date(to_char(add_months(sysdate, -6),'yyyymm') || '01','yyyymmdd') and sbywb_dm='A0305001' and sbtype = 'ZSSB' and sbzl_dm = 'TSSB' and sbzt_dm in ('21', '2A', '2B', '30', '39')) ) group by substr(cmcode,1,8) having sum(tse) > #{pval1}) t where not exists (select 1 from tl_tssh.ckts_sb_mdt_ckmx s where s.djxh =#{cpcode} and substr(s.cksp_dm,1,8) = t.object and s.ckrq_1 >= to_date((to_char(t.lj_date0, 'yyyy') - 2) || '0101', 'yyyymmdd') and s.sbrq < to_date(to_char(add_months(sysdate, -6), 'yyyymm') || '01', 'yyyymmdd')) and not exists (select 1 from tl_admin.yj_data_yjxx u where u.nsrdzdah =#{nsrdzdah} and u.yjcode = '101' and u.zbcode in ('10101','10102') and substr(u.yj_object,1,8) = t.object and u.sbym >= to_char(add_months(sysdate, -6), 'yyyymm')) and exists (select 1 from tl_tssh.glxt_bb_shxt_djxx where djxh_js =#{cpcode} and first_sb_ym < to_char(add_months(sysdate, -6), 'yyyymm'))

select object as yj_object, '' as yj_record, yj_count, yj_amt, yj_tax, cmname from (select substr(cmcode, 1, 6) as object, min(cmname) as cmname, count(*) as yj_count, sum(usd_amt) as yj_amt, sum(tse) as yj_tax, min(lj_date) as lj_date0 from (select min(a.cksp_dm) as cmcode, min(a.sbhgspmc) as cmname, round(sum(a.mylaj)/count(1),2) as usd_amt, sum(b.tse) as tse, min(a.ckrq_1) as lj_date from tl_bjts.ckts_sb_mts_tssb_lsb a, tl_bjts.ckts_sb_mts_tsjh_lsb b where a.sbid in (select id from tl_bjts.sb_sbxx_hz where nsrdzdah = #{nsrdzdah} and sbrq >= to_date(to_char(add_months(sysdate, -6), 'yyyymm') || '01', 'yyyymmdd') and sbtype = 'ZSSB' and sbzl_dm = 'TSSB' and sbzt_dm in ('21', '2A', '2B', '30', '39')) and a.sbid = b.sbid and a.glh = b.glh group by a.glh) group by substr(cmcode, 1, 6) having sum(tse) > #{pval1}) t where not exists (select 1 from tl_tssh.ckts_sb_mts_ckmx s where s.djxh =#{cpcode} and substr(s.cksp_dm, 1, 6) = t.object and s.ckrq_1 >= to_date((to_char(t.lj_date0, 'yyyy') - 2) || '0101', 'yyyymmdd') and s.sbrq < to_date(to_char(add_months(sysdate, -6), 'yyyymm') || '01', 'yyyymmdd')) and not exists (select 1 from tl_admin.yj_data_yjxx u where u.nsrdzdah = #{nsrdzdah} and u.yjcode = '101' and u.zbcode in ('10101', '10102') and substr(u.yj_object, 1, 6) = t.object and u.sbym >= to_char(add_months(sysdate, -6), 'yyyymm')) and exists (select 1 from tl_tssh.glxt_bb_shxt_djxx where djxh_js = #{cpcode} and first_sb_ym < to_char(add_months(sysdate, -6), 'yyyymm'))

WITH FZTJ AS ( SELECT A.DJXH, A.LCSLID, A.GHFNSRSBH_1 AS YJ_OBJECT, MIN(A.GLH) AS YJ_RECORD, COUNT(1) AS YJ_COUNT, SUM(A.JSJE) AS YJ_AMT, SUM(A.TSE) AS YJ_TAX, MIN(A.KPRQ) AS KPRQ0 FROM HX_CKTS.CKTS_SB_MTS_TSJH_GCB A WHERE A.LCSLID = #{lcslid} GROUP BY A.DJXH,A.LCSLID,A.GHFNSRSBH_1 HAVING SUM(A.TSE) > #{pval1} ) SELECT T.LCSLID,T.YJ_OBJECT,T.YJ_RECORD,T.YJ_COUNT,T.YJ_AMT,T.YJ_TAX,y.ckqygllb_dm as ckqygllbDm FROM FZTJ T left join hx_ckts.ckts_ty_ywblxx y on y.djxh=T.DJXH AND nvl(y.zfbz_1, 'N') = 'N' AND nvl(y.FFBZ, 'N') = 'N' and y.lcslid=T.LCSLID WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HX_CKTS.CKTS_SB_MTS_TSJH_JGB S WHERE S.DJXH = T.DJXH AND S.GHFNSRSBH_1 = T.YJ_OBJECT AND S.KPRQ >=ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(T.KPRQ0,'YY'),-24))

select object as yj_object, '' as yj_record, yj_count, yj_amt, yj_tax from (select object, count(1) as yj_count, sum(amt) as yj_amt, sum(tse) as yj_tax, min(kprq) as kprq0 from (select a.ghfnsrsbh_1 as object, a.jsje as amt, a.tse as tse, a.kprq from tl_bjts.ckts_sb_mts_tsjh_lsb a where sbid in (select id from tl_bjts.sb_sbxx_hz where nsrdzdah = #{nsrdzdah} and sbrq >= to_date(to_char(add_months(sysdate, -6), 'yyyymm') || '01', 'yyyymmdd') and sbywb_dm='A0301001' and sbtype = 'ZSSB' and sbzt_dm in ('21', '2A', '2B', '30', '39')) ) group by object having sum(tse) > #{pval1}) t where not exists (select 1 from tl_tssh.ckts_sb_mts_jhmx s where s.djxh =#{cpcode} and s.ghfnsrsbh_1 = t.object and s.kprq >= to_date((to_char(t.kprq0, 'yyyy') - 2) || '0101', 'yyyymmdd') and s.sbrq < to_date(to_char(add_months(sysdate, -6), 'yyyymm') || '01', 'yyyymmdd'))
and not exists (select 1 from tl_admin.yj_data_yjxx u where u.nsrdzdah =#{nsrdzdah} and u.yjcode = '102' and u.zbcode in ( '10201', '10202') and u.yj_object = t.object and u.sbym > to_char(add_months(sysdate, -6), 'yyyymm'))

WITH GLMX AS ( SELECT A.DJXH,A.LCSLID,SUBSTR(A.CKBGDH,1,18) AS YJ_OBJECT,A.GLH AS YJ_RECORD,A.MYLAJ, C.HZDWDQ_DM,D.HZDWDQ_MC,D.XZQH_DM,B.SBXH,B.JSJE,B.TSE,B.GHFNSRSBH_1, (CASE WHEN DJ.ZGSWJ_DM IS NOT NULL AND SUBSTR(DJ.ZGSWJ_DM,2,LENGTH(D.XZQH_DM))=D.XZQH_DM THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) * (CASE WHEN LENGTH(B.GHFNSRSBH_1)=18 AND SUBSTR(B.GHFNSRSBH_1,5,2)='00' AND SUBSTR(B.GHFNSRSBH_1,3,2)=SUBSTR(D.XZQH_DM,1,2) THEN 0 WHEN LENGTH(B.GHFNSRSBH_1)=18 AND SUBSTR(B.GHFNSRSBH_1,5,2)<>'00' AND SUBSTR(B.GHFNSRSBH_1,3,LENGTH(D.XZQH_DM))=D.XZQH_DM THEN 0 WHEN LENGTH(B.GHFNSRSBH_1)>=15 AND LENGTH(B.GHFNSRSBH_1)<>18 AND SUBSTR(B.GHFNSRSBH_1,1,LENGTH(D.XZQH_DM))=D.XZQH_DM THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS HYDYZ FROM HX_CKTS.CKTS_SB_MTS_TSSB_GCB A INNER JOIN HX_CKTS.CKTS_SB_MTS_TSJH_GCB B ON A.DJXH=B.DJXH AND A.GLH=B.GLH INNER JOIN HX_CKTS.CKTS_WBSJ_HG_BGD201 C ON C.DJXH=A.DJXH AND C.CKBGDH=A.CKBGDH INNER JOIN FXGL_DM_HZDWDQ D ON D.HZDWDQ_DM=C.HZDWDQ_DM LEFT JOIN HX_DJ.DJ_NSRXX DJ ON COALESCE(DJ.SHXYDM,DJ.NSRSBH)=B.GHFNSRSBH_1 AND DJ.KZZTDJLX_DM='1110' AND DJ.NSRZT_DM='03' WHERE A.LCSLID=#{lcslid} AND A.CKBGDH IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT A.DJXH,A.LCSLID,SUBSTR(A.DLZMH,1,18) AS YJ_OBJECT,A.GLH AS YJ_RECORD,A.MYLAJ, C.JNHYD_DM AS HZDWDQ_DM,D.HZDWDQ_MC,D.XZQH_DM,B.SBXH,B.JSJE,B.TSE,B.GHFNSRSBH_1, (CASE WHEN DJ.ZGSWJ_DM IS NOT NULL AND SUBSTR(DJ.ZGSWJ_DM,2,LENGTH(D.XZQH_DM))=D.XZQH_DM THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) * (CASE WHEN LENGTH(B.GHFNSRSBH_1)=18 AND SUBSTR(B.GHFNSRSBH_1,5,2)='00' AND SUBSTR(B.GHFNSRSBH_1,3,2)=SUBSTR(D.XZQH_DM,1,2) THEN 0 WHEN LENGTH(B.GHFNSRSBH_1)=18 AND SUBSTR(B.GHFNSRSBH_1,5,2)<>'00' AND SUBSTR(B.GHFNSRSBH_1,3,LENGTH(D.XZQH_DM))=D.XZQH_DM THEN 0 WHEN LENGTH(B.GHFNSRSBH_1)>=15 AND LENGTH(B.GHFNSRSBH_1)<>18 AND SUBSTR(B.GHFNSRSBH_1,1,LENGTH(D.XZQH_DM))=D.XZQH_DM THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS HYDYZ FROM HX_CKTS.CKTS_SB_MTS_TSSB_GCB A INNER JOIN HX_CKTS.CKTS_SB_MTS_TSJH_GCB B ON A.DJXH=B.DJXH AND A.GLH=B.GLH INNER JOIN HX_CKTS.CKTS_WBSJ_ZJ_DLCKHWZM C ON C.DJXH=A.DJXH AND C.TSSWJG_DM_1=A.TSSWJG_DM_1 AND C.DLCKHWZMHM=A.DLZMH INNER JOIN FXGL_DM_HZDWDQ D ON D.HZDWDQ_DM=C.JNHYD_DM LEFT JOIN HX_DJ.DJ_NSRXX DJ ON COALESCE(DJ.SHXYDM,DJ.NSRSBH)=B.GHFNSRSBH_1 AND DJ.KZZTDJLX_DM='1110' AND DJ.NSRZT_DM='03' WHERE A.LCSLID=#{lcslid} AND A.CKBGDH IS NULL ), BYZMX AS ( SELECT DJXH,LCSLID,YJ_OBJECT,YJ_RECORD,MYLAJ,HZDWDQ_DM,HZDWDQ_MC,XZQH_DM,SBXH,JSJE,TSE,GHFNSRSBH_1, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY YJ_RECORD ORDER BY JSJE DESC) AS JSMY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY YJ_OBJECT ORDER BY JSJE DESC) AS XSYJ FROM GLMX T WHERE HYDYZ=1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM GLMX S WHERE S.YJ_OBJECT=T.YJ_OBJECT AND S.HYDYZ=0) ), BYZTJ AS ( SELECT YJ_OBJECT,COUNT(1) AS YJ_COUNT,SUM(CASE WHEN JSMY=1 THEN MYLAJ ELSE 0 END) AS YJ_USD,SUM(JSJE) AS YJ_AMT,SUM(TSE) AS YJ_TAX FROM BYZMX GROUP BY YJ_OBJECT HAVING SUM(TSE)>#{pval1} ) SELECT DJXH,BYZMX.LCSLID,BYZMX.YJ_OBJECT,BYZMX.YJ_RECORD,BYZTJ.YJ_COUNT,BYZTJ.YJ_USD,BYZTJ.YJ_AMT,BYZTJ.YJ_TAX, BYZMX.HZDWDQ_DM as hzdwdqdm, BYZMX.HZDWDQ_MC as hzdwdqMc, BYZMX.XZQH_DM, BYZMX.GHFNSRSBH_1 as ghfns_no FROM BYZMX INNER JOIN BYZTJ ON BYZTJ.YJ_OBJECT=BYZMX.YJ_OBJECT WHERE BYZMX.XSYJ=1

select distinct glh as yj_record, 1 as yj_count, max(cksp_dm) as yj_object, max(spmc_ck) as hgcmname, max(spmc_jh) as cmname, sum(jsje) as yj_amt, sum(tse) as yj_tax from (with T as (select a.glh, b.sbxh, a.ckbgdh, a.cksp_dm, replace(to_single_byte(substr(a.sbhgspmc,instr(a.sbhgspmc,'*',1,2)+1)),' ','') as spmc_ck, a.mylaj, b.jsje, b.tse, replace(to_single_byte(substr(b.sbhgspmc,instr(b.sbhgspmc,'*',1,2)+1)),' ','') as spmc_jh from tl_bjts.ckts_sb_mts_tssb_lsb a, tl_bjts.ckts_sb_mts_tsjh_lsb b where a.sbid = #{sbid} and a.sbid = b.sbid and a.glh = b.glh) select ckbgdh, glh, jsje, tse, spmc_ck,spmc_jh,cksp_dm from T T1 where T1.spmc_ck <> T1.spmc_jh and not exists (select 1 from T T2 where T2.glh = T1.glh and T2.sbxh <> T1.sbxh and T2.spmc_ck <> T2.spmc_jh)) group by glh having sum(tse)>#{pval1}

select t.ghfnsrsbh_1 as yj_object, min(t.glh) as yj_record, count(1) as yj_count, sum(t.jsje) as yj_amt, sum(t.tse) as yj_tax from tl_bjts.ckts_sb_mts_tsjh_lsb t where t.sbid = #{sbid} and exists (select 1 from tl_admin.yj_cs_ycghqy s where s.nsrsbh = t.ghfnsrsbh_1 and #{swjgdm} like s.swjgfw || '%' and (s.jzrq is null or sysdate <= s.jzrq) and s.yxbz = 'Y') group by t.ghfnsrsbh_1 having sum(t.tse) >= #{pval1}

select object as yj_object, '' as yj_record, yj_count, yj_amt, yj_tax from (select object, count(1) as yj_count, sum(amt) as yj_amt, sum(tse) as yj_tax from (select a.ghfnsrsbh_1 as object, a.jsje as amt, a.tse as tse from tl_bjts.ckts_sb_mts_tsjh_lsb a where sbid in (select id from tl_bjts.sb_sbxx_hz where nsrdzdah = #{nsrdzdah} and sbrq >= to_date(to_char(add_months(sysdate, -6), 'yyyymm') || '01', 'yyyymmdd') and sbywb_dm='A0301001' and sbtype = 'ZSSB' and sbzt_dm in ('21', '2A', '2B', '30', '39')) ) group by object having sum(tse) > #{pval1}) t where exists (select 1 from tl_admin.yj_cs_ycghqy s where t.object = s.nsrsbh and #{swjgdm} like s.swjgfw || '%' and (s.jzrq is null or sysdate <= s.jzrq) and s.yxbz = 'Y') and not exists (select 1 from tl_admin.yj_data_yjxx u where u.nsrdzdah = #{nsrdzdah} and u.yjcode = '107' and u.zbcode in ( '10701', '10702') and u.yj_object = t.object and u.sbym > to_char(add_months(sysdate, -6), 'yyyymm'))

WITH SB_JGB AS ( SELECT NVL(SUM(T.MYLAJ),0) AS JGB_MYLAJ, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN T.LRRQ>=ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE,'MM'),-2) THEN T.MYLAJ ELSE 0 END),0) AS JGB_3M FROM HX_CKTS.CKTS_SB_MDT_TSSB_JGB T INNER JOIN HX_CKTS.CKTS_WBSJ_HG_BGD201 S ON S.DJXH=T.DJXH AND S.CKBGDH=T.CKBGDH INNER JOIN HX_CKTS.CKTS_TY_YWBLXX R ON R.DJXH=T.DJXH WHERE R.LCSLID=#{lcslid} AND T.LRRQ>=DATE'2026-04-01' AND T.TSSWJG_DM_1 NOT LIKE '13307%' AND S.SBDWDM LIKE '33189%' ), SB_GCB AS ( SELECT NVL(SUM(T.MYLAJ),0) AS GCB_MYLAJ, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN T.LRRQ>=ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE,'MM'),-2) THEN T.MYLAJ ELSE 0 END),0) AS GCB_3M FROM HX_CKTS.CKTS_SB_MDT_TSSB_GCB T INNER JOIN HX_CKTS.CKTS_WBSJ_HG_BGD201 S ON S.DJXH=T.DJXH AND S.CKBGDH=T.CKBGDH INNER JOIN HX_CKTS.CKTS_TY_YWBLXX R ON R.DJXH=T.DJXH WHERE R.LCSLID=#{lcslid} AND T.LRRQ>=DATE'2026-04-01' AND T.TSSWJG_DM_1 NOT LIKE '13307%' AND S.SBDWDM LIKE '33189%' ), SB_LC AS ( SELECT NVL(SUM(T.MYLAJ),0) AS LC_MYLAJ, MIN(T.SBXH)||'('||COUNT(T.SBXH)||')' AS LC_SBXH FROM HX_CKTS.CKTS_SB_MDT_TSSB_GCB T INNER JOIN HX_CKTS.CKTS_WBSJ_HG_BGD201 S ON S.DJXH=T.DJXH AND S.CKBGDH=T.CKBGDH WHERE T.LCSLID=#{lcslid} AND T.LRRQ>=DATE'2026-04-01' AND T.TSSWJG_DM_1 NOT LIKE '13307%' AND S.SBDWDM LIKE '33189%' ) SELECT LC_MYLAJ as lcMylaj,LC_SBXH as lcSbxh, JGB_MYLAJ+GCB_MYLAJ AS mylajAll,JGB_3M+GCB_3M AS mylaj3m FROM SB_LC INNER JOIN SB_JGB ON 1=1 INNER JOIN SB_GCB ON 1=1

WITH SB_JGB AS ( SELECT NVL(SUM(T.MYLAJ),0) AS JGB_MYLAJ, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN T.LRRQ>=ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE,'MM'),-2) THEN T.MYLAJ ELSE 0 END),0) AS JGB_3M FROM HX_CKTS.CKTS_SB_MTS_TSSB_JGB T INNER JOIN HX_CKTS.CKTS_WBSJ_HG_BGD201 S ON S.DJXH=T.DJXH AND S.CKBGDH=T.CKBGDH INNER JOIN HX_CKTS.CKTS_TY_YWBLXX R ON R.DJXH=T.DJXH WHERE R.LCSLID=#{lcslid} AND T.LRRQ>=DATE'2026-04-01' AND T.TSSWJG_DM_1 NOT LIKE '13307%' AND S.SBDWDM LIKE '33189%' ), SB_GCB AS ( SELECT NVL(SUM(T.MYLAJ),0) AS GCB_MYLAJ, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN T.LRRQ>=ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE,'MM'),-2) THEN T.MYLAJ ELSE 0 END),0) AS GCB_3M FROM HX_CKTS.CKTS_SB_MTS_TSSB_GCB T INNER JOIN HX_CKTS.CKTS_WBSJ_HG_BGD201 S ON S.DJXH=T.DJXH AND S.CKBGDH=T.CKBGDH INNER JOIN HX_CKTS.CKTS_TY_YWBLXX R ON R.DJXH=T.DJXH WHERE R.LCSLID=#{lcslid} AND T.LRRQ>=DATE'2026-04-01' AND T.TSSWJG_DM_1 NOT LIKE '13307%' AND S.SBDWDM LIKE '33189%' ), SB_LC AS ( SELECT NVL(SUM(T.MYLAJ),0) AS LC_MYLAJ, MIN(T.GLH)||'('||COUNT(T.GLH)||')' AS LC_GLH FROM HX_CKTS.CKTS_SB_MTS_TSSB_GCB T INNER JOIN HX_CKTS.CKTS_WBSJ_HG_BGD201 S ON S.DJXH=T.DJXH AND S.CKBGDH=T.CKBGDH WHERE T.LCSLID=#{lcslid} AND T.LRRQ>=DATE'2026-04-01' AND T.TSSWJG_DM_1 NOT LIKE '13307%' AND S.SBDWDM LIKE '33189%' ) SELECT LC_MYLAJ as lcMylaj,LC_GLH as lcGlh, JGB_MYLAJ+GCB_MYLAJ AS mylajAll,JGB_3M+GCB_3M AS mylaj3m FROM SB_LC INNER JOIN SB_JGB ON 1=1 INNER JOIN SB_GCB ON 1=1
